te: Bangkok monkey-cheek retention areas, a petition on a town-plan road line in Nong Chok, state property land in Sikhio, and letters sent to the Governors of 3 north-eastern provinces
se: The subcommittee reported on a complaint about road lines Kh.2–Kh.3 near Khlong Lam Pla Thio, Nong Chok District, and on approaches to Bangkok's water-retention and storage areas. The meeting asked Nakhon Ratchasima Province for information on compensation for tenants of state property land in a reserved forest in Khlong Phai Subdistrict, Sikhio District, and wrote to the governors of Chaiyaphum, Amnat Charoen and Ubon Ratchathani about complaints from the Senators-meet-the-people project (water for household use, land and wastewater ponds).
it: Central and Provincial Subcommittee: complaint about the alignment of roads Kho.2–Kho.3 in the draft Bangkok Comprehensive Plan (revision 4), Khlong Lam Pla Thio, Nong Chok District / water retention and storage areas of Bangkok
Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): seminar on the Licensing Facilitation Act, 20 November 2026, 08.00–16.00 hrs, Rama Gardens Hotel
Disaster Subcommittee: flood preparedness in Bangkok, disaster warnings and the drainage system
Remedy for damage from leasing state property land (the petitioner asks for a remedy, not for a review of the court's judgment), Khlong Phai Subdistrict, Sikhio District, Nakhon Ratchasima Province

Senators-meet-the-people, lower north-east, 3 matters: lack of water for household use, Khok Sa-at Subdistrict, Nong Bua Rawe District, Chaiyaphum / land in Non Nam Thaeng Subdistrict, Amnat Charoen / the area around the wastewater ponds, Ubon Ratchathani City Municipality
Appointment of 1 honorary advisers

te: Meeting summary video · Bangkok monkey-cheek retention areas, a petition on a town-plan road line in Nong Chok, state property land in Sikhio, and letters sent to the Governors of 3 north-eastern provinces
Work plan for fiscal year 2027: 8 site visits in 5 regions, 2 seminars, and a disaster-education course in schools
se: The meeting set the work plan for fiscal year 2027: site visits in 5 regions, 8 times (budget 1.1 million baht), for example land title deeds pending for over 60 years in Li District, Lamphun Province; 2 seminars (20 Nov and 24 Dec 2026); and study topics on civil service reform, the State Administration Act, appointments of senior executives and disaster management, aiming at about 6 reports a year. The disaster subcommittee also reported on a trial of the Office of the Basic Education Commission's disaster-education activity kit in 51 schools.
it: Disaster Subcommittee: (Meeting No. 9/2569, 22 October): disaster education by the Office of the Basic Education Commission, trial of 6 activity sets in 51 schools in 17 educational service areas / review of the incident command system

Work plan for fiscal year 2027: site visits to 5 regions, 8 times, budget 1,100,000 baht (for example, land title deeds pending for more than 60 years in Li District, Lamphun Province, and conservation town plans for old town areas)
2 seminars, budget 500,000 baht: the facilitation law on 20 Nov 2026 at the Rama Gardens Hotel, and a disaster seminar (expected 24 Dec 2026)

Study topics: civil service reform and staffing (amending the State Administration Act B.E. 2534 (1991)), corruption prevention, the merit system in appointing executives/governors, value for money of projects, building-control law for floods; target ~6 reports/year

te: Meeting summary video · Work plan for fiscal year 2027: 8 site visits in 5 regions, 2 seminars, and a disaster-education course in schools
Bangkok floods: forecasting, drainage, town planning; a complaint about a road line in the Bangkok Comprehensive Plan; and the draft Domestic Violence Act
se: The disaster subcommittee reported on approaches to flood management in Bangkok: forecasting and warnings, drainage and land use. Another subcommittee is preparing a seminar on 20 November 2026 with King Prajadhipok's Institute. The meeting asked for information to be gathered on complaints objecting to road lines Kh.2 and Kh.3 in the draft Bangkok Comprehensive Plan (revision 4), and considered the principles of the draft Act on the protection of victims of domestic violence.
it: Central and Provincial Subcommittee: review and improvement of the draft study report

Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): seminar on putting the Licensing Facilitation Act into effect, 20 November 2026, Rama Gardens Hotel, with King Prajadhipok's Institute
Disaster Subcommittee: flood management in Bangkok (forecasting and warning, drainage, city planning, data integration)
Complaint objecting to planned road lines Kh.2 and Kh.3 in the draft Bangkok Comprehensive Plan (revision 4)
Draft Act on the Protection of Victims of Domestic Violence B.E. ....: timely protection, definitions of violence and of family members, assistance measures
Appointment of 2 honorary advisers

te: Meeting summary video · Bangkok floods: forecasting, drainage, town planning; a complaint about a road line in the Bangkok Comprehensive Plan; and the draft Domestic Violence Act
6 initial proposals on entertainment venues, and study begins on the draft Act on the protection of victims of domestic violence
se: After hearing government agencies and the private sector over several meetings, the committee summarised 6 areas of preliminary observations on the Service Establishments Act B.E. 2509 (1966): legal reform, proactive inspections, building standards, integration, oversight after licensing and zoning, through to the responsibility of officials. It began studying the draft Act on the Protection of Victims of Domestic Violence, and wrote to the Department of Lands, the Treasury Department, and the Governors of Chumphon and Ranong about a complaint received concerning alleged encroachment on state land in the South
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted
Complaint about dealing with encroachment on state land and destruction of natural resources in the south

Entertainment Venues Act B.E. 2509 (1966), Lat Phrao beer-house case: 6 initial proposals (law / proactive inspection / building standards / integration / supervision after licensing–zoning / responsibility of officials–participation)
Draft Act on the Protection of Victims of Domestic Violence B.E. ....
1 honorary advisers ended their term; 2 academics and 3 honorary advisers appointed

te: Meeting summary video · 6 initial proposals on entertainment venues, and study begins on the draft Act on the protection of victims of domestic violence
Meeting 32/2569 · Committee on Administration of State Affairs
Area-based policy plan report completed, a facilitation-law seminar planned for 20 Nov, and the Immigration Bureau and the Department of Provincial Administration explain the draft Acts
se: The subcommittee reported that its study of policy plans as a framework for area-based national development is complete and will be submitted to the Senate. Another subcommittee asked approval to hold a seminar on readiness under the Facilitation Act B.E. 2569 (2026) on 20 November 2026. The meeting wrote to the Governor of Phang Nga about a complaint on checking the qualifications of village-headman candidates, and heard the Immigration Bureau and the Department of Provincial Administration on the draft Hotel and Immigration Acts.
it: Central and Provincial Subcommittee: the study on policy plans as a framework for area-based national development at all levels is complete and will be presented to the Senate

Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): request for approval to hold a seminar on preparing for the Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration and Public Services B.E. 2569 (2026), on 20 November 2026, Asawin Grand Convention Hotel
Complaint about the process of checking the qualifications of village-headman candidates in Phang Nga Province
Draft Hotel Act and draft Immigration Act: the Immigration Bureau and the Department of Provincial Administration explain the outcome at the House ad hoc committee stage and their concerns

te: Specific town plans to conserve old towns, mud from dredging the Tha Chin River, and the draft Hotel and Immigration Acts
se: The subcommittee invited the Office of Natural Resources and Environmental Policy and Planning and the President of the Thai Planners Association to study the conservation and development of old towns, and proposed a forum on putting the Facilitation Act B.E. 2569 (2026) into practice. The meeting wrote to the Ministry of Interior and the Marine Department about the rules for using mud dredged from the Tha Chin River, and began considering the draft Hotel and Immigration Acts, inviting the Department of Provincial Administration and the Immigration Bureau to give information.
it: Central and Provincial Subcommittee: specific town plans, case study on urban conservation (inviting ONEP and the President of the Thai Planners Association)

Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): proposal to hold a forum on implementing the Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration and Public Services B.E. 2569 (2026)
Follow-up on public motorcycle-taxi stands, and pay/welfare for workers in Nan Province
Senators-meet-the-people, lower central region: request to amend the law/rules on using mud dredged from the Tha Chin River channel
Draft Hotel Act (No. ..) and draft Immigration Act (No. ..): principles, reasons and section-by-section review

te: Night-time business operators propose controlling "opening and closing hours by risk level" instead of zoning, and section-by-section review of the draft Act begins
se: Representatives of the night-time business confederation, the food and tourism trade association and the restaurant business association proposed central standards for building inspection, sound systems, fire-fighting equipment and maximum occupancy, and control through opening and closing hours by type and risk level instead of mainly zoning. The meeting collected the proposals, summarised the study visit on integrated provincial administration in Saraburi, and agreed to consider the draft Hotel and Immigration Acts section by section.
it: Results of the work of 3 subcommittees noted

Operators' proposals on the Lat Phrao beer-house case: (1) a central standard for inspecting buildings, sound systems, fire-fighting systems and maximum occupancy; (2) control opening and closing hours by type/risk, rather than mainly by zoning
Summary of the study visit on integrated provincial administration, Saraburi Province, 27–28 Aug 2026
Draft Hotel Act (No. ..) and draft Immigration Act (No. ..) under Rule 119

te: Study of the draft Immigration Act and Hotel Act taken up; police asked to be proactive in controlling venues similar to entertainment venues
se: The meeting took up for advance study the draft Immigration Act (No. ..) and the draft Hotel Act (No. ..), whose principles the House of Representatives has accepted. After hearing the Royal Thai Police and the Metropolitan Police Bureau, the committee was of the view that police should supervise venues similar to entertainment venues proactively, grade them by risk and watch repeat offenders. There were also reports on specific town plans, readiness under the facilitation law, and the sponge-city idea.
it: Central and Provincial Subcommittee: specific town plans and the conservation of old buildings not yet registered as ancient monuments (Malaysia case study)

Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): readiness under the Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration and Public Services B.E. 2569 (2026) (manuals, E-Service, Super License, Fast Track, data linking)
Disaster Subcommittee: risk-area maps, building standards, GIS, SHM systems and Sponge City; adjusting the membership of provincial town planning committees
Draft Immigration Act (No. ..) and draft Hotel Act (No. ..), whose principles the House of Representatives accepted in first reading (Rule 119)
Complaint about the management of farmland under the National Land Policy Committee (KTC) policy, Huai Kaeo Subdistrict, Mae On District, Chiang Mai

Proposal by the Secretary-General of the Southern Border Provinces Administrative Centre that the Cabinet clearly delegate administrative powers under the Southern Border Provinces Administration Act B.E. 2553 (2010)
Entertainment venues and venues similar to them, Lat Phrao beer-house case: the Royal Thai Police and the Metropolitan Police Bureau explain

te: The armed forces, GISTDA and the Royal Thai Survey Department on forecasting hazards in advance, and the Excise Department on liquor-sale licences
se: The disaster subcommittee heard the Royal Thai Survey Department, the Armed Forces Development Command and GISTDA propose a Joint SOP, a Common Operating Picture and One Map, to move from "waiting to respond" to "being ready and forecasting ahead". Another subcommittee is preparing a readiness report under the Facilitation Act B.E. 2569 (2026), which takes effect on 4 January 2027. The Excise Department explained liquor-sale licences and the entertainment-venue tax, and the meeting took up a complaint about farmland of 74 families in Muang Tuet Subdistrict, Nan Province.
it: Special compensation for renewable-energy sugarcane farmers in Tak Province (effects of cadmium, under the Cabinet resolution of 11 September 2012)
“Community Builds Life” project, Khlong Toei: the Port Authority of Thailand reported a target of housing 26 communities on 20 per cent of the area, near the original communities
Study visit on integrated provincial administration, Uthai Thani Province, 2–3 Sep 2026
Speeding up the proof of rights to farmland of the original communities of Ban Muang Tuet–Ban Si Bun Rueang, Muang Tuet Subdistrict, Phu Phiang District, Nan Province (74 families)
Central and Provincial Subcommittee: report title changed to “Driving urban development through specific town plans under the Town Planning Act B.E. 2562 (2019)” (including the revival of old towns)

Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): report on the readiness of agencies under the Ministry of Interior for the Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration and Public Services B.E. 2569 (2026) (in force from 4 January 2027): citizen's manuals, E-Service, Super License, Fast Track

Disaster Subcommittee: the Royal Thai Survey Department (DEM, LiDAR), the Armed Forces Development Command (“civilians lead, the military supports”) and GISTDA (satellites, AI, Digital Twin, SAR) → Joint SOP, COP, One Map, and amending the law so the military can help from the first stage

Liquor sale licences and service establishment tax (5 per cent of revenue) in the Lat Phrao beer venue case: the Excise Department clarified its zoning checks before issuing licences and its enforcement

te: Noise from shops resembling service establishments: the Pollution Control Department and the Department of Health noted that local authorities lack by-laws and tools
se: The subcommittee reported on visits to 5 provinces, which found that Damrongtham Centres lack the power to speed up cases and to link data, and proposed that the military and civilian sides work together as one in responding to disasters. The meeting heard the Pollution Control Department and the Department of Health on noise pollution and nuisances: local administrative organisations lack by-laws, staff and measuring equipment, so they proposed a stronger role for provincial public health committees and a central database.
it: Central and Provincial Subcommittee: issues at Damrongtham Centres (powers to expedite follow-up, data linking) from site visits to 5 provinces
Disaster Subcommittee: the role of the armed forces in supporting disaster prevention and mitigation; proposed military–civilian integration and a clear chain of command

Noise pollution and nuisance from venues similar to entertainment venues: the Pollution Control Department (standards/measurement) and the Department of Health (Public Health Act) say local administrative organisations lack by-laws, staff, tools and budgets for night inspections

te: Village security teams still unpaid, follow-up from Chaiyaphum, Si Sa Ket and Nan, and agencies explain how venues similar to entertainment venues are controlled
se: The Department of Provincial Administration explained that village security teams (Chor Ror Bor) are still unpaid because no regulation provides for it. Chaiyaphum, Si Sa Ket and Nan provinces reported on follow-up of complaints (in Nan, 133 people are still waiting for title deeds). On the Lat Phrao beer-house case, the Department of Provincial Administration and the Department of Local Administration explained their powers and duties and their instructions to step up inspections, and the meeting will invite the Pollution Control Department and the Department of Health next time.
it: Work of 3 subcommittees noted

Welfare of village security teams (Chor Ror Bor): still unpaid because no regulation provides for it; if injured or killed, they have rights under the Act on Assistance to Victims of Hazards B.E. 2543 (2000)
Road between Kra Hat and Nong Chim subdistricts, Chaiyaphum: Kra Hat SAO has asked the Department of Local Administration for a budget
Si Sa Ket: no plan to subsidise farm machinery / a drainage system for Kanthararom has been proposed in the fiscal year 2028 plan
Nan: 133 people waiting for title deeds in Ban Tha Li, Ban Nam Lom and Ban Tha Chang
Entertainment Venues Act, Lat Phrao beer-house case: the Department of Local Administration and the Department of Provincial Administration explain their powers and duties and stepped-up inspections
